purpose: Teach: 櫃/鷯/豺/厘/平蔵/少佐/空海/膣

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、骨董の櫃、つまり長持の盗難を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: The police are investigating this case of the antique chest theft, correct?
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal. Soft rise on the question tag. Thoughtful pause before speaking, as if organizing complex information. Even breath, no urgency.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、希少野鳥、つまり鷯属の密猟事案も対応されますね
lines.en: And the police are handling the rare wren poaching case as well, I understand?
lines.style: Calm, confirmatory tone. Professional courtesy. A slight nod in the voice—affirming what's already known. Patient delivery, collaborative rather than interrogative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、害獣の豺、つまり野犬出没情報を、警察、把握されますね
lines.en: So the police have records of the wild dog sightings in this area, I assume?
lines.style: Quiet curiosity underneath. Gentle question, not demanding. A moment of hesitation before the final clause, like he's double-checking his own logic. Respectful of the officer's time.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、骨董の厘銭、つまり厘単位古銭の盗難捜査もされますね
lines.en: And the police are also investigating the theft of those antique small coins, correct?
lines.style: Even-paced, slightly formal. A confirming statement more than a question. Steady eye contact in the voice. No performance, just careful documentation of facts.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、鬼平、つまり鬼の平蔵にちなんだ騙り事案を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: This case involves the fraud inspired by Onihei—the famous historical figure. The police are looking into it?
lines.style: Careful framing before the question. Slight breathiness as he explains the reference. A moment of self-consciousness about whether the officer will recognize the allusion. Quiet at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧軍少佐ゆかりの遺品事案も対応されますね
lines.en: The police are also handling the matter of heirlooms connected to the former military officer, I gather?
lines.style: Respectful, deferential phrasing. Acknowledges the delicate nature of handling historical figures' property. Steady tone, not pushing. A slight lift at the end—genuine question, not assumption.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、空海ゆかりの文化財盗難を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: And regarding the cultural property theft connected to Kobo Daishi—the police are investigating that too?
lines.style: Reverent acknowledgment of the historical significance. Slower pace on the name. A pause before the question, honoring the subject matter. Quiet delivery, almost meditative.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、産婦人科関連の膣盗撮事件も慎重に対応されますね
lines.en: The police are handling the voyeurism case with appropriate sensitivity, I trust?
lines.style: Serious, quiet. A careful choice of words. The softest delivery of the entire exchange. No judgment in the voice, only gravity and a deep sense that this requires care. Delicate breath control.
